display.purpose: Hero headline only; stacked masked lines, final line in Lilac.

body.purpose: Running copy in Soft Ink; hero sub uses clamp(1rem, 1.4vw, 1.125rem), measure ~34rem.

label.purpose: Nav links and the name-role byline.

action.purpose: Button labels; the language toggle runs a smaller cousin (0.8125rem / 700 / +0.06em).

shadows.name: spark-signature
shadows.purpose: The canonical light form: white core, lilac halo, deep-violet ambience. Worn by the hero spark.

shadows.name: button-glow-rest
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest — the spark signature scaled down.

shadows.name: button-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover — glow brightens and widens with a -2px lift.

shadows.name: dot-glow
shadows.purpose: Wordmark's 6px lilac dot. Emission only; no lifting drop shadows exist in this world.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single house easing for every entrance and transform.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Color, border, and opacity micro-transitions on plain ease.

motion.name: spark-period
motion.purpose: Spark breathe (opacity 0.75 to 1) and ripple ring cycle, ease-in-out.

motion.name: entrance-schedule
motion.value: scene 1.6s/2.8s from scale(1.06); title lines rise from 110% mask at delays 0.5s/0.63s/0.76s; byline 0.95s; sub 1.05s; actions 1.2s; nav 1.1s; cue 1.7s
motion.purpose: Orchestration gated on body.is-loaded (hero image load, 2.5s fail-safe). Reduced motion collapses all of it to 0.4s opacity fades.

motion.name: parallax
motion.value: target +/-14px x, +/-10px y; lerp 0.06 via rAF
motion.purpose: Fine pointers only, never under reduced motion; the scene drifts toward the cursor.

breakpoints.name: mobile-nav
breakpoints.purpose: Nav wraps to second row, scroll cue hidden, display type steps down, scene nudged +6% right, parallax off.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one lit object: lilac gradient pill wearing the spark's light signature. Main CTA only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.85rem 1.7rem; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Satoshi', 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.015em; text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--lilac-mid, #a78bfa), var(--lilac-deep, #7c5cd6)); color: var(--on-lilac, #0d0817); box-shadow: 0 0 10px -2px rgba(255,255,255,0.28), 0 4px 24px -6px rgba(124,92,214,0.6); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 14px -2px rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 0 8px 32px -6px rgba(167,139,250,0.7); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lilac-mid, #a78bfa); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: luminous 1px lilac border over blurred translucent room-tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.85rem 1.7rem; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Satoshi', 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.015em; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid rgba(196,176,255,0.3); color: var(--ink, #f2eff9); background: rgba(20,18,29,0.35); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(196,176,255,0.65); background: rgba(124,92,214,0.12); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lilac-mid, #a78bfa); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: EN/KA pill chip; active language lights up in Lilac, border brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem; background: rgba(20,18,29,0.55); border: 1px solid rgba(196,176,255,0.18); border-radius: 999px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); font-family: 'Satoshi', 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--ink-faint, #877ca6); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-lang-toggle:hover { border-color: rgba(196,176,255,0.45); } .ds-lang-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lilac-mid, #a78bfa); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-lang-opt { transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-lang-opt.ds-is-active { color: var(--lilac, #c4b0ff); } .ds-lang-divider { color: rgba(196,176,255,0.25); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Soft Ink label that warms to Ink while a 1px lilac underline scales in from the left — light passing under the word.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0; font-family: 'Satoshi', 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-soft, #b6abd1); transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: var(--lilac, #c4b0ff); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink, #f2eff9); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lilac-mid, #a78bfa); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: The Spark
components.description: Signature light: 8px white core with lilac halo, breathing on a 3.4s cycle with a rippling 1px ring. Pinned in image space on the hero; reuse this signature wherever the brand needs a live point of light.
components.css: .ds-spark-stage { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 120px; background: var(--bg, #0b0a10); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-spark { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 12px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 0 0 34px 12px rgba(196,176,255,0.55), 0 0 90px 40px rgba(124,92,214,0.28); animation: ds-spark-breathe 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-spark-ring { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border: 1px solid rgba(196,176,255,0.7); animation: ds-spark-ripple 3.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-spark-breathe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.75; } 50% { opacity: 1; } } @keyframes ds-spark-ripple { 0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); opacity: 0.8; } 70%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(7); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-spark { animation: none; } .ds-spark-ring { display: none; } }

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: Bottom-center invitation: uppercase micro-label over a 1px lilac light line with a white pulse falling through it. Hidden at <=760px.
components.html: Scroll
components.css: .ds-scroll-cue { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink-faint, #877ca6); font-family: 'Satoshi', 'Noto Sans Georgian', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-scroll-cue:hover { color: var(--lilac, #c4b0ff); } .ds-scroll-cue-line { width: 1px; height: 44px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--lilac-mid, #a78bfa), transparent); overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .ds-scroll-cue-line::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -100%; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, #fff); animation: ds-cue-drop 2.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-cue-drop { 0% { top: -100%; } 60%, 100% { top: 100%; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-scroll-cue-line::after { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The whole system lives inside one charged gap: a human hand and a machine hand a breath apart, with a live spark in between. The world is a near-black violet room (#0b0a10) — not a page with a dark theme, but a room the visitor stands inside. Everything luminous in the room belongs to a single lilac family (#c4b0ff → #7c5cd6), and that family arrives as light, not as paint: the spark's halo, a rim on chrome, a text-selection wash, a focus ring, a glowing underline. The only place lilac is allowed to become a solid material is the primary call-to-action, which borrows the spark's own light signature (white core, lilac halo).

The voice is calm confidence. Clash Display (medium, tightly leaded) speaks; Satoshi carries the body; Noto Sans Georgian sits in every stack as a first-class sibling, not a fallback — the site is genuinely bilingual and Georgian copy is held to the same craft bar as English. Density is low: one idea per viewport, generous gutters, copy anchored bottom-left so the photograph keeps the room.

Motion is the comp. Entrances are orchestrated (scene → headline lines → byline → sub → actions → nav → cue) on a single easing curve, the spark breathes on a 3.4s cycle, and the scene drifts a few pixels toward the cursor. Under prefers-reduced-motion all of it collapses to quiet opacity fades. The build confirms the contract's refusals: no grid-of-projects opener, no split text/illustration hero, no gray-on-dark text.
keyCharacteristics: One room (near-black violet), one light family (lilac), no second hue.
Accent carried by light — glow, border, selection, focus — almost never by fill.
Secondary text is tinted lilac (#b6abd1 / #877ca6), never neutral gray.
Clash Display voice + Satoshi body + Noto Sans Georgian as an equal sibling script.
Pure white reserved for the cores of light sources; text ink is #f2eff9.
One easing curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for every movement; opacity-only fallback for reduced motion.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Fills Rule
rules.body: Lilac reaches the screen as light: glow, rim, border at 0.18–0.7 alpha, selection, focus, gradient on the one primary action. It never becomes a large flat fill or a section background. If a new surface wants lilac, it gets a halo or an edge, not a coat of paint.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: There is no neutral gray anywhere on the dark. Every de-emphasized text step (#b6abd1, #877ca6) and every chrome tint (#14121d, scrollbar #2b2440) carries the room's violet.

rules.name: The White Core Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#fff) appears only as the core of a light source — the spark's center, the falling pulse in the scroll-cue line, the inner ring of the primary button's glow. Text and surfaces never use it; ink is #f2eff9.

rules.name: The Sibling Script Rule
rules.body: Georgian is first-class: Noto Sans Georgian appears in every font stack, :lang(ka) zeroes letter-spacing (Georgian never takes Latin tracking), and every visible string ships as a data-en/data-ka pair swapped by the language toggle (which also updates <html lang> and its own aria-label in the other language). New copy is not done until both languages are written.

rules.name: The Formal Register Rule
rules.body: Georgian copy uses the formal plural register ("იხილეთ ნამუშევრები", "დამიკავშირდით"), matching the professional tone of the English.

rules.name: The Image-Space Pin Rule
rules.body: When an overlay must align with a feature of a photograph (the spark at the fingertip gap), it is not positioned in viewport space. The photograph lives in a .hero-scene wrapper sized to its own 16:9 box covering the viewport (width: max(100vw, 177.78vh); height: max(100vh, 56.25vw), centered), and the overlay is pinned to percentages of that box (--spark-x: 46.5%; --spark-y: 51.5%). The pin then survives every viewport shape.

rules.name: The Emission-Only Rule
rules.body: A box-shadow may describe light leaving an element (white core + lilac halo), never darkness beneath it. If an element needs separation from the room, it gets translucency and blur, or a veil — not a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Quiet Fallback Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-motion, all entrances become 0.4s opacity fades with transforms stripped, the spark stops breathing, the ripple ring hides, and parallax never binds. Reduced motion is a first-class rendering of the world, not a broken one.

dos: Do deliver lilac as light — glow, 1px low-alpha border, selection, focus ring, underline — and reserve solid lilac for the primary CTA's gradient alone.
Do tint every secondary text and chrome color into the violet family (#b6abd1, #877ca6, #14121d); run the No-Gray audit on any new hex before it ships.
Do keep Noto Sans Georgian in every font stack, ship every string as a data-en/data-ka pair in formal-register Georgian, and let :lang(ka) zero the letter-spacing.
Do use the single house easing cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all movement, gate entrances on .is-loaded, and provide the opacity-only reduced-motion path for anything that moves.
Do pin photo-anchored overlays in image space via a 16:9 cover wrapper and percentage coordinates, per the Image-Space Pin Rule.
donts: Don't use neutral gray text or surfaces on the dark room, and don't use pure #fff for text — white belongs only to light-source cores.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; the world has one lilac family, dark to light.
Don't cast drop shadows to lift surfaces; separation comes from translucency, blur, and veils (the Emission-Only Rule).
Don't collapse mobile navigation into a hamburger; links wrap to a second row and stay visible.
Don't add kickers/eyebrows above headlines. The uppercase letterspaced micro-style exists only as the scroll cue's label; it is not a headline-introducer pattern.
Don't open any surface with a grid-of-projects or a split text/illustration composition; each surface opens inside one charged moment.
